successCriteria.description: Exactly one `addMonths` implementation exists in the codebase — the export in `src/shared/date/accrual.ts` — and `src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts` imports it from that module with no local/private `addMonths` definition.
The balance module (`src/modules/balance/`) contains no import of the leave-type module; `LeaveTypeService` and `PgLeaveTypeRepository` are not referenced anywhere under `src/modules/balance/`.

`createBalanceService()` still returns a working `IBalanceService` whose `getBalanceForEmployee` resolves effective policies and returns correct `BalanceEntry` values — the existing balance unit tests pass unchanged, proving no behavior change.
`npm run build` (tsc --noEmit) succeeds and the full Jest suite passes after the refactor.

constraints: No observable behavior change to any balance operation (openPeriod, carryForward, getBalance, getBalanceById, getBalanceForEmployee) or to the GET /balances/me route.
Cross-module imports only through public entry points (index.ts); the balance module must not reach into leave-type internals.
The shared `addMonths` in src/shared/date/accrual.ts remains the single source of truth for month arithmetic — no re-implementation in any consumer.
Dependency direction is balance → policy → leave-type; balance must not depend directly on leave-type.
outOfScope: No changes to the leave module's own construction of LeaveTypeService (leave → leave-type is permitted as the orchestrator).
No new endpoints, entities, migrations, or audit/notification behavior.
No changes to the shared addMonths/periodContaining/startOfUtcDay arithmetic itself.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: unchanged — returns a concrete IBalanceService wired with PostgreSQL-backed collaborators

interfaceConstraints.authRule: auth enforced at route boundary (resolveActor); service method itself is unauthenticated
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: unchanged — read-only, no transaction; NotFoundError only for unknown employee via getEmployeeById

consistencyRequirements.requirement: `addMonths` must be the shared symbol imported from `src/shared/date/accrual.ts` (not a local re-implementation).
The balance module must obtain its `IPolicyService` through the policy module's public entry point rather than constructing a `LeaveTypeService`.
The balance module's public entry point must continue to export `createBalanceService`, `IBalanceService`, `BalanceService`, `BalanceEntry`, and `balanceRoutes` unchanged.

single source of truth for addMonths consumed by balance.service.ts
